job-not-found: There is no download job with this id among yours; list_jobs lists them with their ids.
search-not-found: There is no search with this id among yours from the last day; run search_releases again.
send-held-folder-not-seen: This destination's download client can't see its folder, so nothing will be sent there until the owner fixes the destination under Destinations in the user menu.
arguments-dont-fit: The arguments don't fit {{tool}}: {{reason, vendor}} Check them against the tool's input schema and call it again.
